remarks: Turn-key 1 bedroom, 1 full bathroom condo ideally located in the heart of downtown Stamford. This home is within walking distance of the Stamford Town Center, restaurants, entertainment, and local parks. Don't miss this opportunity to own a move-in-ready condo in a prime downtown location.
